description: This file defines a partial struct 'Writer<TBufferWriter>' within the Orleans.Serialization.Buffers namespace. It provides methods for writing start and end object tags using a tag-delimited wire protocol, including writing start object, end object, and end base tags.

classes.name: Writer<TBufferWriter>
classes.description: A partial struct responsible for serializing data into a buffer, specifically for writing object tags in a tag-delimited format.

methods.name: WriteStartObject
methods.description: Writes the start tag for an object, including field ID and type information, using a wire type indicating tag-delimited encoding.

methods.name: WriteEndObject
methods.description: Writes the end object tag, signaling the conclusion of an object in the serialization stream.

methods.name: WriteEndBase
methods.description: Writes the end base fields tag, indicating the conclusion of a base object in the serialization process.
